title: Quick Indian Curry with Lettuce Wrap
description: A simple and flavorful Indian-inspired curry served with a crisp lettuce wrap, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add curry and quick to skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add coconut milk and water to skillet and stir to combine.
Return chicken to skillet and simmer for 2-3 minutes or until sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve curry over lettuce leaves as wraps.
